articles.title: Quoting Prompting Claude Fable 5.2
articles.summary: Claude Fable 5.2 pays close attention to who owns the code it works on. In Anthropic’s testing on small coding tasks, the model tended to add to the existing structure when the prompt said nothing about ownership or presented the code base as someone else’s, even when that duplicated existing code. When the prompt said the code base was the model’s own, it often consolidated duplicated code and sometimes made related fixes without being asked. articles.title: Glue work is still harmful in the age of AI
articles.summary: I am not a believer in glue work1. Processes that can only be sustained by the unrewarded sacrifice of engineers ought to die. Now that LLMs are writing most of our code, does that free human engineers up to do more glue work? No, it doesn’t. I think glue work is actually less important to companies than it was in the 2010s. articles.title: Working with designers
articles.summary: I love working with designers, in part because (unlike managers and product managers) they’re culturally different from engineers.
